next.reason: 1985: a) an unchanged alternate key keeps its retrieval order; b) a changed one may reorder, and with duplicates the record is logically positioned last. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR24 a) and b) restate both ('the record is logically positioned last within the set of duplicate records'); §2023:14.9.30.4 GR26 orders REWRITE-created duplicates by release. The collating-sequence words make the equality explicit; NOTE 5 (shared files) is informative and suppression needs the 2023-only SUPPRESS WHEN phrase.
